Subject: FinSecure — Post-call recap & VPC/private deployment interest

Thanks again for taking the time today, Daniel — great conversation. Quick recap from our discovery call and suggested next steps: 

Summary of needs
- Primary drivers: data residency + stricter access controls, predictable latency for real-time fraud scoring, and SOC 2 / audit readiness.
- Expected monthly throughput: ~50M tokens (batch + some streaming) across US regions.
- Key stakeholders: Engineering (real-time infra), Security/Compliance, Procurement.

Recommendation
- Given the compliance and network controls you mentioned, a Private deployment (VPC or on-prem) or Redwood Dedicated (reserved GPU pools in your VPC) looks like the best fit. Both options give you tenant isolation and KMS integration. Hosted could work for dev/test but likely won't meet your compliance checklist.

Immediate next steps
1) I can share our SOC 2 packet + VPC architecture diagram (will attach in next email).
2) If helpful, schedule a 60-minute technical session with Jonas (solutions/infra) to walk through networking, KMS, and rollout options.
3) Procurement: if you can share target timeline/budget window we can draft a mutual action plan and a ballpark pricing worksheet.

Would you be available for a technical deep-dive next week? If not, what is your expected procurement decision window?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole

- Hosted API (managed): $0.35 / 1k tokens (variable, good for dev/test)
- Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity in your VPC): $18k–$45k / month depending on committed throughput and GPU class
- Private (customer-managed on-prem or VPC private control plane): typically $25k–$70k / month + one-time setup (networking, KMS integration) depending on scale and on-prem hardware costs

Compliance & ops
